regions.today: Mild and cloudy today with patches of mist and drizzle. Sunny spells will develop later on in the day, with the odd isolated shower falling. Light to moderate southerly winds, with highest temperatures of 14 to 18 degrees, cooler on southeast coasts.
regions.tonight: Cloudy and dry with mist and fog patches forming towards morning. Lowest temperatures of 7 to 10 degrees in mostly light southwest winds.
regions.tomorrow: Dry and warm with sunny spells.Highest temperatures of 17 to 21 degrees. Mostly light to southwest winds, fresh to strong along coasts.
